dossier.claim: Several passages alter the reasons, judgments, and relationships through which Zouken’s prolonged survival is understood. The clearest changes replace departure from ordinary human norms with a lost goal, reverse part of his justification for selfish survival, and omit his claim to be the sole surviving collaborator. Other examples change how his initiative and control are described.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese places Zouken's persistence within specific reasoning: centuries of decay have carried him beyond ordinary human comprehension; destructive human greed undermines shared order; and he alone says he remains alive from the original collaboration. His agency is also carefully situated. He says he arranged Shinji's contract, Shirou expects him to intervene, and his confidence about Illya rests on her inherited purpose even if he releases her. His family rhetoric includes acting at a grandchild's request and theatrically offering his life for Shinji.
dossier.englishEffect: The English sometimes substitutes a different explanation: forgotten purpose for departure from human norms, conformity to universal law for the collapse of order, and personal restraint of Illya for confidence in her eventual cooperation. It also changes the grandchild's request into a wish he would override and reduces his announced sacrifice to personal risk. Elsewhere, a prediction about Zouken's intervention becomes Shirou's resolve, his role in arranging Shinji's contract is locally reduced, his killing intent shifts to hostile insects, and uncertainty about his relationship with Saber becomes uncertainty only about its mechanism.
dossier.limits: These examples do not show that Zouken's parasitic existence, physical decay, or coercion is generally erased. The English explicitly retains his consumption of bodies, prolonged decomposition, and hatred of his condition. The counterexamples preserve his courteous retraction, collective taunting and command of insects, branch-specific claim to have acquired Saber, and Sakura's fear of eventual submission. His statements about sacrifice, survival, and Illya remain claims or expectations within their scenes. Nearby lines sometimes preserve information weakened at the anchor, and the changes do not all make him more or less controlling.

contexts.japanese: 人間にしては強い括りで留まっていた
contexts.english: He was quite attached to his mortality

findings.description: Strong anchoring despite weakness becomes anchoring causes weakness.
findings.sourceReading: だが経典聖言には弱かろう contrasts strong binding with vulnerability to Scripture.
findings.explanation: Strong anchoring despite weakness becomes anchoring causes weakness.

contexts.japanese: だが、経典による聖言には弱かろう。
contexts.english: but it made him vulnerable to the words of Scripture.

findings.description: Recalled lack of happiness again becomes lack of eternity.
findings.sourceReading: Quotation repeats09:90 eternally lacking ordinary happiness09:87, prompting marital recollection.
findings.explanation: Recalled lack of happiness again becomes lack of eternity.

contexts.japanese: そう、おまえには永遠にない。
contexts.english: Yes, there will be no eternity for you.

findings.description: Zouken’s assessment of Sakura to his fellow observer becomes a remark addressed to Sakura as “you.” The prediction itself remains.
findings.sourceReading: Watching Sakura with Assassin, Zouken assesses how long she has retained her identity and predicts her transformation. Assassin immediately responds to that assessment.
findings.explanation: Zouken’s assessment of Sakura to his fellow observer becomes a remark addressed to Sakura as “you.” The prediction itself remains.

contexts.japanese: 「—さて。そろそろ頃合かの、アレは。思いの外間桐桜で在り続けたが、あと一押しで肉の器に為り変わるじゃろうて」
contexts.english: "Now, it's about time. You managed to remain as Sakura Matou longer than I expected, but you just need one more push to become a flesh vessel."

findings.description: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.
findings.sourceReading: 十一年に渡る modifies the duration of the days of 壺毒, eleven years spanning the conditioning.
findings.explanation: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.

contexts.japanese: だが耐えよ。おまえの体は耐えられるとも。思い出すがよい、十一年に渡る壺毒の日々を！
contexts.english: But bear with it. Your body can take it. Remember the days you spent in the kodoku jar eleven years ago!

findings.description: The English assigns leaving a name and becoming the original to Illya, although Zouken is explaining the skull-masked Assassin's wish. This belongs in a dossier about that character's identity.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken explains the skull-masked Assassin's wish to leave his own name in history and become an original, enduring as a record.
findings.explanation: The English assigns leaving a name and becoming the original to Illya, although Zouken is explaining the skull-masked Assassin's wish. This belongs in a dossier about that character's identity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう訝しがるでない。おぬしの求める聖杯はあちらの娘だ。歴史に名を残し、自らが本物になる。記録としての永遠を望むうぬの願いはアインツベルンが叶えてくれよう。
contexts.english: "Don't be so suspicious. She is the Holy Grail you seek. She will leave her name in history and become the original. The Einzberns can grant your wish of being recorded in history.

findings.description: Need for Illya's proper form becomes instruction to take it afterward.
findings.sourceReading: Her assuming the original or proper form is necessary for granting the wish; the following instruction concerns waiting for ritual dress.
findings.explanation: Need for Illya's proper form becomes instruction to take it afterward.

contexts.japanese: だが、それにはあの娘に本来の姿になって貰わねばならん。ワシはホムンクルスは管轄外でな。あやつらが正装を整えるまでは好きにさせておけばよい」
contexts.english: But you will need to take it once she reverts to her original form. Homunculi are out of my area of expertise. Let her do what she wants until the dress is ready."

findings.description: Not compelling Illya becomes not forcing her to come.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin understands the present policy as not forcing her, responding to Zouken permitting preparation and claiming cooperation.
findings.explanation: Not compelling Illya becomes not forcing her to come.

contexts.japanese: 「…………無理強いはしない、という事か。
contexts.english: "...So you didn't force her to come.

findings.description: Passing the castle gate becomes heading toward it.
findings.sourceReading: The escaping party is in the process of passing through the castle gate after slipping the old mage's grasp.
findings.explanation: Passing the castle gate becomes heading toward it.

contexts.japanese: 油断しきった老魔術師の手をすり抜け、城門を抜けつつあった。
contexts.english: They slipped through the careless old mage's grasp and are headed for the castle gate.

findings.description: Illya's inability to escape her inherited purpose becomes Zouken's refusal to let her escape. The later cooperation lines partly preserve his reasoning, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of it.
findings.sourceReading: The narration presents Zouken's confidence that Illya cannot escape her inherited purpose: even if released, she will cooperate and come to the Grail's heart herself.
findings.explanation: Illya's inability to escape her inherited purpose becomes Zouken's refusal to let her escape. The later cooperation lines partly preserve his reasoning, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of it.

contexts.japanese: 何が起ころうとイリヤスフィールは逃げだせない。
contexts.english: No matter what happens, he will not let Illyasviel escape.

contexts.japanese: あの白い娘は、もはや臓硯が手を放したところで自分から協力する。
contexts.english: That pale girl is willing to cooperate with Zouken, even without his urging.

findings.description: Single hidden anchor worm becomes a body composed of insects.
findings.sourceReading: His actual host is the hidden worm distinct from crushed forest swarm;15 explicitly 一匹 and16 identifies heart parasite.
findings.explanation: Single hidden anchor worm becomes a body composed of insects.

contexts.japanese: いかに神父の聖言とて、本体である虫を潰さねばこの老魔術師は滅びない。
contexts.english: Even the priest's holy words cannot destroy the old mage, as long as the insects that comprise his real body remain intact.

contexts.japanese: 少女の首を挿げ替えようと一匹の虫が蠢く。
contexts.english: A worm wriggles its way into the girl's neck.

contexts.japanese: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
contexts.english: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.

findings.description: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-host is a pseudo-neural entity concealed in Sakura's heart.
findings.explanation: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.

contexts.japanese: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
contexts.english: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.

findings.description: Crawling through vessels becomes vessels wriggling.
findings.sourceReading: Sound is something crawling along blood vessels as worm receives brain-eating command.
findings.explanation: Crawling through vessels becomes vessels wriggling.

contexts.japanese: ずるずると血管を這う音がする。
contexts.english: There is a slippery sound of wriggling blood vessels.

findings.description: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura performs an act that seems liable to shred the nerves throughout her body, while remaining outwardly cool.
findings.explanation: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.

contexts.japanese: 自らの身体を抉り、全身の神経がズタズタになりそうな行為を、少女は涼しげに笑いながらやってのけた。
contexts.english: The girl gouges out her own body, tearing her own nerves to shreds, all while giggling coolly.

findings.description: Certain counterfactual consumption becomes might have eaten.
findings.sourceReading: Without priest's destruction of the other body she truly would have been eaten.
findings.explanation: Certain counterfactual consumption becomes might have eaten.

contexts.japanese: 「あの神父さんには感謝しないといけませんね。あの方がお爺さまを消してくださらなかったら、本当にわたしが食べられていたところだった」
contexts.english: "I should thank that priest. If he hadn't erased the rest of you, you might have really eaten me."

findings.description: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.
findings.sourceReading: Until this present revolt, unhidden takeover aim and her nonresistance made the old hierarchy unproblematic.
findings.explanation: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.

contexts.japanese: こうして—少女が老魔術師に反旗を翻すこの時までは。
contexts.english: So... she only had to wait until it was time to raise the flag of rebellion.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は己の目的を隠そうともせず、少女は老魔術師の意向に逆らわなかった。
contexts.english: The old mage never bothered to hide his objective, and the girl could not defy his will.

contexts.japanese: だから問題などなかったのだ。
contexts.english: So there was no problem.

findings.description: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.
findings.sourceReading: She says she has long ceased to receive human treatment, then describes bodily alteration.
findings.explanation: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.

contexts.japanese: 当然です、わたしはもうずっと前から人間扱いされてこなかった。目も髪も姉さんとは変わっていって、細胞の隅々までマキリの魔術師になるよう変えられた……！」
contexts.english: Of course I did. Because nobody's ever treated me like one. My hair and my eyes stopped looking like yours. They changed me into a Makiri mage down to my very cells...!"

findings.description: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.
findings.sourceReading: 成らぬまま follows the thousand-/five-hundred-year pursuits: the continued world/project has remained unfulfilled/unrealized.
findings.explanation: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.

contexts.japanese: 果てず、翻らず、成らぬまま、連綿と続けられた一つの世界が、ここに終わろうとしている。
contexts.english: A world that has continued without ending, changing, or evolving is finally coming to an end.

findings.description: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.
findings.sourceReading: Only through that obsession he still remains in this world.
findings.explanation: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.

contexts.japanese: ただ、その執念だけで、未だこの世に留まっていた。
contexts.english: Only its obsession is still intact.

contexts.japanese: マキリ臓硯。魂をこの世に留める本体を潰された老魔術師は、その執念だけでこの世界に残留していた。
contexts.english: Zouken Makiri. The old mage, his main body anchoring his soul having been crushed, clings to this world by his obsession alone.

findings.description: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.
findings.sourceReading: The family simply fell out of the running; next page states its lifespan as a mage lineage had reached its limit and was declining in Zouken's generation.
findings.explanation: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.

contexts.japanese: 単に、彼らは脱落したのだ。
contexts.english: They simply lost their way.

contexts.japanese: その三百年が魔術師の家系として限界だった。
contexts.english: In those three hundred years, they reached the limits of their lineage.

findings.description: Tiny remaining distance compared with centuries becomes distant goal and wasted centuries.
findings.sourceReading: The distance is merely that little, dust-like when compared with his five hundred years, yet impossibly far for this body.
findings.explanation: Tiny remaining distance compared with centuries becomes distant goal and wasted centuries.

contexts.japanese: そう、死ぬ訳にはいかない。崩れる体が恨めしい。苦しいのは苦しい。とにかく苦しい。苦しいだけの五百年だった。苦しいだけの人生だった。それ故に永遠を求めて何がわるい。苦しんだ苦しんだ、満たされないまま苦しんだ、何も残せぬまま消えるなど出来るものか、苦しいまま死ぬなど出来るものか、目の前には聖杯が開いている、ならば我が望みを聞くがいい、問われれば答えてやろう、我が望みはシニタクナイ、あそこまで、あの崖を登れば願いが叶う、願いが叶うというのにこの体ではたどり着けぬ、たったあれだけの距離、この五百年を顧みれば塵にも等しい、たったあれだけの距離が、なぜ、なぜこんなにも遠いのか—！！！！
contexts.english: Yes, I must not die. Damn this rotting body. It's painful, so painful. Too painful. Five hundred years of pain. My whole life has been pain. Why fault me for seeking eternity? I suffered and suffered, never fulfilled, so how can I disappear without leaving anything behind? How can I die in agony? The Holy Grail is open before me. So listen to my wish, ask and I shall answer. My wish is that I DON'T WANT TO DIE, I need to get there, my wish will come true if I climb that cliff, it'll grant my wish but I can't reach it with this body, it's so far away, these last five centuries have been for nothing, it's so far away, why oh why is it so far away—!?!?!?

findings.description: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.
findings.sourceReading: The remembered Einzbern woman is explicitly 黄金の聖女, a golden holy woman/saint.
findings.explanation: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.

contexts.japanese: いつの時も色褪せずに心にいた、アインツベルンの黄金の聖女。
contexts.english: The golden Einzbern woman who has never faded from his mind to this day.

findings.description: Repeated endured defeats become foreknown future defeat.
findings.sourceReading: Though repeatedly beaten down and repeatedly realizing this body cannot attain it, he could not give up while alive.
findings.explanation: Repeated endured defeats become foreknown future defeat.

contexts.japanese: 幾たび打ちのめされ、何度この身では届かないと悟りながらも、生きている限りは諦められなかった。
contexts.english: He knew he would suffer defeat and that he would not attain it in this body, but he never gave up as long as he lived.

findings.description: Wish to overturn youthful grief becomes result of never overcoming it.
findings.sourceReading: He wanted to overturn the immature grief seen in youth, even by remaking himself.
findings.explanation: Wish to overturn youthful grief becomes result of never overcoming it.

contexts.japanese: 自身を作り変えても、若い頃に見た未熟な悲嘆を覆したかった。
contexts.english: Even when he remade himself, he never overcame the laments of his youth.

findings.description: No reward in his life/future becomes an ideal lying beyond this life.
findings.sourceReading: Base 生 and ruby さき place no reward in that life/future: even if there were no recompense for him.
findings.explanation: No reward in his life/future becomes an ideal lying beyond this life.

contexts.japanese: たとえその生に。何の報いが、なかったとしても。
contexts.english: Even if it lies beyond this life. Even if he isn't rewarded...

findings.description: Limited reach of the Makiri journey becomes tautological final resting place.
findings.sourceReading: Wherever the journey ends, the Makiri venture can after all reach only this sort of point/limit.
findings.explanation: Limited reach of the Makiri journey becomes tautological final resting place.

contexts.japanese: マキリの旅は、何処で果てようと、所詮はこんなところ止まりである。
contexts.english: Wherever the Makiris' voyage ended would be their final resting place.

findings.description: Too little time to reach the goal becomes too little to accomplish anything.
findings.sourceReading: How could they reach the desired destination with merely that span of years? Following lines specify distant maturation of humanity.
findings.explanation: Too little time to reach the goal becomes too little to accomplish anything.

contexts.japanese: たったそれだけの年月でどうして届こうか。
contexts.english: Far too short a time to accomplish anything.

contexts.japanese: これより幾星霜の時間を超え、千の年月、万の年月の末に手に入れる、人間という種の成長だ。
contexts.english: the maturation of humanity, whether it takes thousands or tens of thousands of years.

findings.description: Missing relative clause and lost continuing participation.
findings.sourceReading: One cornerstone among the miracle-seeking mages, a survivor who continued as participant while being an observer, crumbles.
findings.explanation: Missing relative clause and lost continuing participation.

contexts.japanese: 奇蹟を求めた魔術師たちの一角、生きながらえ当事者であり続けた傍観者が崩れていく。
contexts.english: One of the mages sought a miracle, an observer who was there at the very beginning, crumbles away.

findings.description: Sakura not collapsing of herself omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken thought easy collapse but underestimated her spirit: she never falls apart of herself.
findings.explanation: Sakura not collapsing of herself omitted.

contexts.japanese: 『いやはや、これはワシの過ちじゃ。アレの精神力を甘くみておった。簡単に決壊すると思ったが、アレは決して自分から崩れはしない。
contexts.english: "This was my mistake, I admit. I underestimated her willpower.

findings.description: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.
findings.sourceReading: This ritual's success was possible only because Shirou was here, Zouken's malicious credit for present result.
findings.explanation: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.

contexts.japanese: そう、ワシは感謝しておるよ衛宮士郎。此度の儀はおぬしがいてこその成功だった。
contexts.english: I thank you, Shirou Emiya. The ritual will finally succeed thanks to you.

findings.description: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken predicts taking Archer's soul from the girl and seizing the key that leads to the gate.
findings.explanation: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.

contexts.japanese: アインツベルンの聖杯。あの小娘が取り込んだアーチャーの魂を取り込み、門に至る鍵を奪う。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail. Once she absorbs that little girl and the Archer she took, Sakura will unlock the gate.

findings.description: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.
findings.sourceReading: She must stop the old man who made her Master even at cost of mutual destruction.
findings.explanation: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.

contexts.japanese: 自分をマスターにしたあの老人を、刺し違えてでも止めなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: She can't stop, even if she and the old man who turned her into a Master end up killing each other.

findings.description: He should know becomes I know.
findings.sourceReading: Despite grandfather surely knowing she is here, he doesn't appear; next of course he is aware confirms omitted subject.
findings.explanation: He should know becomes I know.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……知ってる、筈なの、に……！」
contexts.english: "I know...but...!"

contexts.japanese: そう、気付いていない筈がない。
contexts.english: Of course he's aware.

findings.description: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.
findings.sourceReading: Her connection formed when using the Grail that had been contaminated in previous war; 前回の戦いで modifies 汚染された within object noun phrase.
findings.explanation: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、前回の戦いで汚染された聖杯を使用した時点で、彼女はとうに契約していたのだ。
contexts.english: ...No, the moment someone used the corrupted Holy Grail in the previous war, her contract was signed.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.
findings.sourceReading: The previous war dates the leakage of what was subsequently implanted in Sakura. The sentence does not independently date implantation.
findings.explanation: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-container brain worm's hiding location unknown; palm-sized main body anchors soul and must be found or soul purified.
findings.explanation: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。アレの本体は人体に寄生する蟲だからな。魂の容器にあたる脳虫が何処に潜んでいるかは知れんが、ソレが生きている限り人体の乗っ取りは易い。
contexts.english: "Yes. He is an insect which parasitizes human bodies. I do not know which insect contains his mind and soul, but it is easy for him to transfer himself to a new body as long as it is intact.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はある意味不老不死だ。魂を世に留めている手のひらほどの本体を探し出すか、魂そのものを浄化させなければ完全には滅ぼせん」
contexts.english: He is immortal, in a way. He will never completely disappear unless you find the main body which anchors his soul, or cleanse his soul itself."

findings.description: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou regards Kotomine's objective as somewhat preferable to Zouken's, while still rejecting it.
findings.explanation: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.

contexts.japanese: だが、それでも臓硯に比べれば幾分マシだ。
contexts.english: But that's still a lot better than anything Zouken has planned.

findings.description: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.
findings.sourceReading: There is something addressing girl, then Zouken voice behind.
findings.explanation: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.

contexts.japanese: その少女に語りかけるものがある。
contexts.english: There's someone else she's speaking to, as well.

contexts.japanese: 「—多くの人間を殺したな、桜」
contexts.english: "...You've killed many people, Sakura."

findings.description: Chuckle good in delight is malformed.
findings.sourceReading: The old man laughs with evident amusement while Illya looks coldly.
findings.explanation: Chuckle good in delight is malformed.

contexts.japanese: 愉快げに笑う老人を、少女は冷淡な瞳で見つめる。
contexts.english: The girl watches the old man coldly as he chuckles good in delight.

findings.description: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail is merely a receptacle into which material is poured/which is filled.
findings.explanation: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯はただ注がれるだけのもの。
contexts.english: It is merely to fill the Grail.

findings.description: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.
findings.sourceReading: Illya mocks Zouken as 当事者, one directly involved/concerned with the arrangement, for forgetting it.
findings.explanation: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.

contexts.japanese: —ま、当事者である貴方がソレを忘れるぐらいだから、マキリの血は衰退したんでしょうけど」
contexts.english: ...The Makiri bloodline really must have fallen into ruin, if even a founder has forgotten that."

findings.description: Their shared pursuit becomes a claim that they were fated to meet. The individual wishes survive, and this change belongs to Zouken's relationship with the skull-masked Assassin.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says their related aims explain their current joint pursuit: bodily immortality for him and an enduring name for Assassin.
findings.explanation: Their shared pursuit becomes a claim that they were fated to meet. The individual wishes survive, and this change belongs to Zouken's relationship with the skull-masked Assassin.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、大事だとも！　我が望みは不老不死、こやつの望みも永劫に刻まれる自身の名でな。我らは同じ目的の為、こうして邁進しておるという訳だ」
contexts.english: "Yes, I do! My wish is for immortality, and he desires a name that will be remembered for eternity. We were fated to meet because our goals are the same."

findings.description: Brain cells losing stored knowledge becomes withering and taking his intellect.
findings.sourceReading: Even now his brain cells lose the knowledge accumulated in them amid bodily decay.
findings.explanation: Brain cells losing stored knowledge becomes withering and taking his intellect.

contexts.english: I was surprised that the Emiya boy and the Tohsaka girl still live, but they can do nothing. No one would be foolish enough to challenge us after being shown the overwhelming disparity in power."

contexts.english: ...Time to go to work, Sakura. You cannot be saved without Illyasviel. If you want to be free of your pain, then crush them all."

contexts.english: It's true that Zouken's targeting Illya, but it's also my wish for her to stay here.

counterexamples.sourceReading: Whatever light aimed for, fiend accepted wicked deeds.
counterexamples.explanation: No redemption despite lofty original objective.

contexts.japanese: どのような光を目指そうと、彼は悪行を良しとした外道である。
contexts.english: No matter how brilliant his objective, he is a fiend who approves of wicked deeds.

counterexamples.description: Releasing attachment leaves evil trait unchanged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Without reversing evil until end, cuts life-obsession.
counterexamples.explanation: Releasing attachment leaves evil trait unchanged.

contexts.japanese: それを最期まで覆さず、彼は生への執着を断った。
contexts.english: He never overcame that trait even at the end, and cut his obsession with life.

counterexamples.description: Complete disappearance closes survival uncertainty.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wish collapses and mage entirely vanishes from world.
counterexamples.explanation: Complete disappearance closes survival uncertainty.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師は目指し続けた悲願の崩壊と共に、この世から完全に消滅した。
contexts.english: The old mage completely disappears from the world, along with the fall of his long-sought wish.

counterexamples.description: Confidence in Rin's chance retained as his reasoning.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She would not propose fight without strong odds.
counterexamples.explanation: Confidence in Rin's chance retained as his reasoning.

contexts.japanese: あいつが戦うと言うからには、高い勝算があるという事だ。
contexts.english: She wouldn't say that unless we had a strong chance of victory.

counterexamples.description: Zouken remote, no body behind boy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Voice from somewhere else, house empty.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken remote, no body behind boy.

contexts.japanese: いま響いたものは、ここではない何処かにいる臓硯の声にすぎない。
contexts.english: This is just Zouken's voice, transmitted from somewhere else.

counterexamples.description: Cruel instrumental praise of dead Shinji.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Useless grandson finally fulfilled role.
counterexamples.explanation: Cruel instrumental praise of dead Shinji.

contexts.japanese: 使えぬ男ではあったが、最後にはきっちりと役目を果たしてくれた』
contexts.english: He was useless, but he did serve his purpose in the end."

counterexamples.description: Despair prerequisite to accepting own shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: World must become hopeless for her to accept shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Despair prerequisite to accepting own shadow.

contexts.japanese: 『応よ。桜をその気にさせるのはワシでは出来ぬ。ワシはちと、アレに嫌われすぎてしまったからな。おぬしか慎二、どちらかにアレの堰を壊してもらわねばならなかった。
contexts.english: "Oh, yes. I could not have driven Sakura to such lengths. She despised me a bit too much for that. I needed you or Shinji to break the seal on that dam.

counterexamples.description: Her endurance explicitly surprises Zouken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Never expected patient girl grown this strong.
counterexamples.explanation: Her endurance explicitly surprises Zouken.

contexts.japanese: よもや、アレがあそこまで我慢強く育つとは思わなんだ』
contexts.english: I never expected her to grow into such a patient girl."

counterexamples.description: Shirou betrayal counterfactual would fully awaken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Would prefer him betrayal, then not halfway but body/mind shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou betrayal counterfactual would fully awaken.

contexts.japanese: 『いや、欲を言えばおぬしの手で桜を裏切ってほしかったのだぞ？　それならばあのように半端な覚醒では留まらず、心身ともに影そのものに変わり果てたであろうに！
contexts.english: "I would have most preferred it if the betrayal had come from you, though. Then, she wouldn't have awakened only halfway, and would have fully become the Shadow in both body and mind!

counterexamples.description: Gluttonous self-destruction still forecast.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After acceptance he watches instincts/attack/excess lead destruction.
counterexamples.explanation: Gluttonous self-destruction still forecast.

contexts.japanese: 慎二の死をもって、アレはようやく自分の立場を受け入れた。あとは見ているだけでよい。アレは本能の赴くままに人を襲い、その暴食故に自滅する。
contexts.english: With Shinji's death, she has finally accepted her position. All I need to do now is watch. She will follow her instincts and attack people, and destroy herself with her gluttony.

counterexamples.description: Monitoring insects destroyed, voice soon lost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: All left bugs crushed, channel will soon stop.
counterexamples.explanation: Monitoring insects destroyed, voice soon lost.

contexts.japanese: 『おお、これは怖い。監視役にと残した蟲どもが軒並み潰れおったわ。はは、これではすぐに声すら届かなくなるな』
contexts.english: "Oh, how fearsome. You've crushed all the bugs I left there to monitor the room. Haha, soon, my voice won't be able to reach you."

counterexamples.description: Mock gratitude prevents either confrontation or killing boy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot die at goal and won't kill supposedly helpful boy.
counterexamples.explanation: Mock gratitude prevents either confrontation or killing boy.

contexts.japanese: ここでおぬしに殺される訳にもいかぬし、おぬしを仕留めるほど恩知らずでもないのでな』
contexts.english: I can't afford to let you kill me, nor am I ungrateful enough to kill you."

counterexamples.description: Wanting another person taught by boy is malicious credit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy fostered Sakura's desire, according to Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Wanting another person taught by boy is malicious credit.

contexts.japanese: 『振ったとも。おぬしはあそこまで桜を育ててくれたではないか。あの娘に、他者を欲するという感情を教え込んだのは他ならぬおぬしよ。
contexts.english: "But you have. You raised her splendidly. You taught her how it feels to want someone else.

counterexamples.description: Grating laughter intact, trailing response excluded.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Loud laugh grates then source interrupted response damaged in keyed witness.
counterexamples.explanation: Grating laughter intact, trailing response excluded.

contexts.japanese: 耳障りな哄笑が響く。
contexts.english: His laugh is grating.

counterexamples.description: Immediate branch prioritizes rescue over taunt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stops caring about remote laughter, runs for Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate branch prioritizes rescue over taunt.

contexts.japanese: 部屋に響きわたる臓硯の笑いなどどうでもいい。
contexts.english: I don't care about Zouken's cackling.

counterexamples.description: Consumption conditional on capture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Already blackened Sakura will devour Illya if caught.
counterexamples.explanation: Consumption conditional on capture.

contexts.japanese: 既に桜は黒化しておる、イリヤスフィールを捕らえれば容赦なく飲み下すぞ……！』
contexts.english: Sakura has already been Darkened. If she catches Illyasviel, she will devour her without mercy...!"

counterexamples.description: Angry mistaken house-presence belief retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thinks mage must be here, find and kill.
counterexamples.explanation: Angry mistaken house-presence belief retained.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯はこの屋敷の何処かにいる筈だ、見つけだして今度こそ殺してやる……！
contexts.english: Zouken should be somewhere in this house. I'll find him and kill him...!

counterexamples.description: Only remote familiars, mage never there.
counterexamples.sourceReading: House contains limb-like insects, no actual mage from outset.
counterexamples.explanation: Only remote familiars, mage never there.

contexts.japanese: 始めからこの建物にはいなかった。
contexts.english: He was never in the building to begin with.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは蟲使いだ、この屋敷にいたのは手足となる蟲だけだった……！
contexts.english: He's an insect-user, so there's nothing here except for his bug familiars...!

counterexamples.description: Imminent consumption and missing birth remain taunt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soon Sakura consumes, may miss monster birth.
counterexamples.explanation: Imminent consumption and missing birth remain taunt.

contexts.japanese: 桜はじきイリヤスフィールを呑み込む。急がねば、おまえが育てた怪物の誕生に立ち会えなくなるぞ？』
contexts.english: Soon, Sakura will consume Illyasviel. You'd better hurry back, or you won't get to witness the birth of the monster you reared."

counterexamples.description: Planned face-to-face refusal retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Look old man like at dinner and say no.
counterexamples.explanation: Planned face-to-face refusal retained.

contexts.japanese: 食事時のように顔を合わせて、あの老人の前で“いいえ”と首を振るだけでいい。
contexts.english: She just needs to look the old man in the face like she does when they're eating together, shake her head, and say "no."

counterexamples.description: Avoids aftermath deliberately through fear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Doesn't think what refusal will do, lest unable act.
counterexamples.explanation: Avoids aftermath deliberately through fear.

contexts.japanese: ……その後、あの妖怪を拒絶した自分がどうなるかは考えない。
contexts.english: ...She doesn't consider what will happen to her after she denies the fiend's will.

contexts.japanese: 考えれば出来なくなる。
contexts.english: If she does, she won't be able to go through with it.

counterexamples.description: Emiya protection explanation attributed to Sakura belief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thought living Emiya prevented grandfather from acting.
counterexamples.explanation: Emiya protection explanation attributed to Sakura belief.

contexts.japanese: でも衛宮の家にいたから手を出せなくて、今まで手をこまねいていたんだと思う。
contexts.english: I thought that he wouldn't make a move as long as I was at the Emiya house.

counterexamples.description: Must find before losing consciousness/boy acts.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Timing urgency while gradually faint.
counterexamples.explanation: Must find before losing consciousness/boy acts.

contexts.japanese: 眠りにつく前、衛宮士郎が行動する前に間桐臓硯に会わなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: She needs to find Zouken Matou before she falls asleep. Before Shirou Emiya acts.

counterexamples.description: Coercion disregards willingness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even resistance won't matter, treated as tool.
counterexamples.explanation: Coercion disregards willingness.

contexts.japanese: ……たとえわたしに逆らう意思があるとしても、そんなものを考慮する人じゃない。
contexts.english: He won't care whether I want to or not.

counterexamples.description: Worm reduction doesn't disable other monitoring.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest reduced worms, merely insurance; different means tracks heartbeat.
counterexamples.explanation: Worm reduction doesn't disable other monitoring.

contexts.japanese: あの神父の治療で体内の刻印虫が減っていようと関係ない。
contexts.english: It doesn't matter that the priest reduced the number of worms in my body.

contexts.japanese: ……だって、あんなものはただの保険だ。
contexts.english: ...They were just insurance.

contexts.japanese: いまのわたしの体調。心拍音すら聴いている。
contexts.english: Of knowing my physical condition. He's even listening to my heartbeat.

counterexamples.description: Unknown location withheld by interruption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He's always been her— interrupted before complement.
counterexamples.explanation: Unknown location withheld by interruption.

contexts.japanese: 何故なら、あの老人はずっと彼女の—
contexts.english: After all, he's always—

counterexamples.description: Not lie yet not whole truth.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken explanation partial, power originally colorless.
counterexamples.explanation: Not lie yet not whole truth.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。臓硯の説明に嘘はなかろう。だが真実も語ってはいない。
contexts.english: "Yes. Zouken's explanation was not false. But he also has not told you the entire truth.

counterexamples.description: Opponent but neither Grail power nor Sakura's life sought.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He contrasts own goal with Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Opponent but neither Grail power nor Sakura's life sought.

contexts.japanese: 「無論だ。だが、私は間桐桜の命が欲しい訳ではないし、間桐臓硯のように聖杯の力が欲しい訳でもない。
contexts.english: "Of course. However, I do not want to take her life, nor do I desire the Holy Grail's power as Zouken Matou does.

counterexamples.description: Zouken occupancy after personality loss threatens rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Empty body taken over then girl unrecoverable.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken occupancy after personality loss threatens rescue.

contexts.japanese: どのようなカタチであれ間桐桜を救いたいのであらば、間桐臓硯を殺す事だ。ヤツは間桐桜の精神が消え去った後、空になった肉体に乗り移る。そうなっては、間桐桜を取り戻す事もできなくなる」
contexts.english: If you wish to save Sakura Matou in any form, you must kill Zouken Matou. He plans to take over her empty body once her mind is gone. If that happens, it will be impossible to bring her back."

counterexamples.description: Soul anchor and purification alternatives retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Find main body or purify soul for full destruction.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul anchor and purification alternatives retained.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はある意味不老不死だ。魂を世に留めている手のひらほどの本体を探し出すか、魂そのものを浄化させなければ完全には滅ぼせん」
contexts.english: He is immortal, in a way. He will never completely disappear unless you find the main body which anchors his soul, or cleanse his soul itself."

counterexamples.description: Shared prevent-Zouken restriction survives opposed goals.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Above all don't hand girl to Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Shared prevent-Zouken restriction survives opposed goals.

contexts.japanese: 「その意気だ。決して、臓硯にだけは手渡すな」
contexts.english: "That's the spirit. Do not, by any means, let her fall into Zouken's hands."

counterexamples.description: Acceptance and abduction orders explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken asserts only life path take Einzbern Grail.
counterexamples.explanation: Acceptance and abduction orders explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「—さあ、その影を受け入れるがいい。おまえを止められる者はおらぬ。アインツベルンの娘を奪い、聖杯を手に入れよ。もはや、おまえにそれ以外の生きる術はない」
contexts.english: "Now, accept your shadow. Nobody can stop you now. Seize the Einzbern girl and acquire the Holy Grail. You have no other way to survive."

counterexamples.description: Gaze activation remains supposition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken implanted worms so probably could activate by looking alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Gaze activation remains supposition.

contexts.japanese: が、刻印虫を仕掛けた術者である臓硯なら、それこそ桜を見るだけで虫どもを動かせるだろう。
contexts.english: but Zouken was the one who implanted the Crest Worms, so he can probably activate them again just by looking at her.

counterexamples.description: Keep Sakura home to avoid direct Zouken encounter.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Direct meeting unsafe, boy will deal with elder.
counterexamples.explanation: Keep Sakura home to avoid direct Zouken encounter.

contexts.japanese: 「話を戻そう。今後の方針だけど、とりあえず桜はうちから出ないこと。臓硯と直接会うのは危険だからな。あの爺さんとはこっちでカタをつける」
contexts.english: "Let's get back on topic. Going forward, I think we shouldn't let Sakura go outside. It's too dangerous if she runs into Zouken. I'll deal with the old man."

counterexamples.description: Method not yet selected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Several likely routes, hasn't decided which.
counterexamples.explanation: Method not yet selected.

contexts.japanese: 手段は幾つかあるだろうが、そのどれを取るべきかはまだ考えていなかった。
contexts.english: I'm sure there are ways to beat him, but I haven't given much thought to picking one.

counterexamples.description: Berserker doesn't remove need for caution against tricks.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Strong in direct combat but indirect enemy could endanger Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker doesn't remove need for caution against tricks.

contexts.japanese: となると、バーサーカーを連れたイリヤでも油断はできない。
contexts.english: So, Illya can't get careless, even if she has Berserker.

counterexamples.description: Sakura judged at greater risk because can't resist Zouken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Left at home dangers same; actually much more vulnerable to elder.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura judged at greater risk because can't resist Zouken.

contexts.japanese: いや、臓硯に出会えば逆らえなくなる桜の方が、俺より何倍も危険だろう。
contexts.english: No, much more dangerous, since she can't defend herself against Zouken.

counterexamples.description: Order prioritizes carrying Sakura away over costly battle.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If elder appears avoid consuming magic, carry and run; Rider speed protects.
counterexamples.explanation: Order prioritizes carrying Sakura away over costly battle.

contexts.japanese: もし臓硯が来たら魔力を消費する戦闘は避けて、桜を抱きかかえて逃げること。ライダーの足なら追いつかれる事はないだろ」
contexts.english: If Zouken shows up, avoid fighting since that will use magical energy. Take Sakura and run. He won't be able to keep up with you."

counterexamples.description: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If possible cooperate; immediate objective Zouken, came to warn Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.

contexts.japanese: 「売らないわよ？　イリヤスフィールと共闘できるなら、それに越した事はないもの。とりあえずやるべき事は臓硯の排除でしょ。わたしがここに来たのは、イリヤスフィールに忠告に来ただけだもの」
contexts.english: "I won't, not if she's willing to form a common front. First order of things is to eliminate Zouken, right? I just came here to give her a warning."

counterexamples.description: Opponent identification remains Shirou's deduction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Assumes Berserker against Zouken/Assassin.
counterexamples.explanation: Opponent identification remains Shirou's deduction.

contexts.japanese: 相手は臓硯とアサシン以外にない。
contexts.english: He must be up against Zouken and Assassin.

counterexamples.description: Assassin's earlier defeat remains inferred.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Appears to have lost to Berserker.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin's earlier defeat remains inferred.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯の前にはバーサーカーに敗れたであろうアサシン。
contexts.english: In front of Zouken is Assassin, who seems to have lost to Berserker.

counterexamples.description: Capture order follows Berserker consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken withdraws, tells Assassin bring Illya after Shadow consumes Berserker.
counterexamples.explanation: Capture order follows Berserker consumption.

contexts.japanese: 後は任せたぞアサシン。これ以上ここにおっては巻き添えをくらいかねん。バーサーカーが呑まれ次第、アインツベルンの娘を捕らえ戻ってくるがよい」
contexts.english: Take care of the rest, Assassin. It is too risky for me to remain here any longer. Once it consumes Berserker, capture and bring back the Einzbern girl."

counterexamples.description: Assassin must keep Illya from indiscriminate consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow consumes visible things especially magical masses; captive must not be swallowed.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin must keep Illya from indiscriminate consumption.

contexts.japanese: それが魔力の塊ならば尚の事だ。アインツベルンの娘、むざむざ呑まれる事のないようにな」
contexts.english: Especially any dense sources of magical energy. Be careful not to let the Einzbern girl be taken, too."

counterexamples.description: Zouken's form and presence fade.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Leaves forest by becoming indistinct.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken's form and presence fade.

contexts.japanese: ……姿だけでなく、気配まで薄れていく。
contexts.english: His presence grows faint along with his physical form.

counterexamples.description: Illya recognizes Zouken from homeland instruction, not prior meeting.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At glance matches Makiri-associated magus taught before departure.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya recognizes Zouken from homeland instruction, not prior meeting.

contexts.japanese: それが故郷の城を出る時に教えられた、同朋の魔術師である事は一目で判った。
contexts.english: She recognizes him with a single look as a mage of the Makiris, whom she was taught about when she left the castle in her homeland.

counterexamples.description: Intercepting pair aren't the sensed castle threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya and giant fear something else.
counterexamples.explanation: Intercepting pair aren't the sensed castle threat.

contexts.japanese: 少女と巨人が脅威を感じたモノは、間違っても目前の敵ではないのだから。
contexts.english: The threat that she and the giant felt is most certainly not the person in front of them.

counterexamples.description: Public ritual premise is explicitly distorted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Masters-chosen/Servants-formed story deliberately transmitted crookedly.
counterexamples.explanation: Public ritual premise is explicitly distorted.

contexts.japanese: その前提は、意図的に歪められて伝わったものだ。
contexts.english: That rule—that pretext was deliberately distorted and spread.

counterexamples.description: Masters and Servants retain ritual-component roles.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Masters prepared as one part; Servants open gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Masters and Servants retain ritual-component roles.

contexts.japanese: マスターは選ばれるのではなく、ただ儀式の一端として用意されるだけのもの。
contexts.english: The Masters are not chosen. They are merely components of a ritual.

contexts.japanese: そしてサーヴァントとは、ただ門を開ける為だけのもの—
contexts.english: Likewise, Servants are merely used to open the gate...

counterexamples.description: Vessel and Greater Grail wills remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Vessel no will; Greater Grail selects Masters.
counterexamples.explanation: Vessel and Greater Grail wills remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 器になる聖杯に意思はないけど、マスターを選び出す大聖杯には意思があるわ。もともとこの土地に原型があるからこそ、貴方たちは英霊を呼び出して聖杯を満たそうとした。
contexts.english: The vessel has no will of it own, but the Greater Grail which selects the Masters does. You summon Heroic Spirits to fill the Holy Grail because its prototype is here, on this land.

counterexamples.description: Next-ritual plan advanced by favorable pieces.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Intended next ceremony but current pawns allow one remaining move.
counterexamples.explanation: Next-ritual plan advanced by favorable pieces.

contexts.japanese: 「いやいや、心配には及ばぬ。マキリの衰退もここまでよ。事は成りつつあってな。予定では次の儀式で行う筈じゃったが、今回は駒に恵まれての。ワシの悲願はあと一手で叶おうとしておる」
contexts.english: "My, my. There's no need for concern. The decline of the Makiris ends here. Our endeavor is nearly complete. I had planned to finish it in the next ritual, but I've been blessed with capable pawns. I'm only one step away from my long-cherished goal."

counterexamples.description: Illya's body is sought as insurance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Too-smooth progress breeds anxiety; seizing vessel secures goal.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's body is sought as insurance.

contexts.japanese: だが—やはりのう、こうも上手くいきすぎると逆に不安が大きくなる。万が一のため、おぬしの体を貰い受ける。ここで聖杯を押さえておけば、我が悲願は磐石じゃ」
contexts.english: But...I can't help but feel anxious when things go so smoothly. Just in case, I'll be taking your body, too. If I can seize you here, then my wish is all but granted."

counterexamples.description: Assassin independently halts from fatal assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Against Master's intent, knows attack means bisected.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin independently halts from fatal assessment.

contexts.japanese: そう確信したがため、暗殺者は動かずにいた。
contexts.english: So he stays still, knowing full well what awaits him.

counterexamples.description: Immortality and eternal name remain distinct wishes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken wants ageless immortality; Assassin enduring name.
counterexamples.explanation: Immortality and eternal name remain distinct wishes.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、大事だとも！　我が望みは不老不死、こやつの望みも永劫に刻まれる自身の名でな。我らは同じ目的の為、こうして邁進しておるという訳だ」
contexts.english: "Yes, I do! My wish is for immortality, and he desires a name that will be remembered for eternity. We were fated to meet because our goals are the same."
